name: What is the typical cost of a kitchen renovation in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of a kitchen renovation in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen renovation in Orange County can vary significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the size of your kitchen. Minor cosmetic updates might range from $15,000 to $30,000, while a mid-range renovation involving new cabinets, countertops, and some layout changes could be $30,000 to $70,000. A major renovation with custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and structural modifications can easily exceed $70,000, potentially reaching $100,000 or more. Obtaining detailed quotes from contractors is essential for an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen renovation costs in Orange County range from $15,000 for minor updates to over $70,000 for major remodels, depending on scope and materials.
